title: Holdout-design validation: frozen-input reproduction and cross-model extensions
description: Frozen-input reproduction and fixed RF, Ridge and Tanimoto 1-NN evaluation across six kinase and five non-kinase targets from ChEMBL 37. Includes inputs, policies, API responses, 680 prediction cases, results and offline fresh-training commands. Author-created code is separately licensed MIT; ChEMBL-derived records retain CC BY-SA 3.0. Windows full training was executed. No Linux full-training or publisher-original certification is claimed.
